model_match_evidence.method: Case/punctuation normalization; compared all 294 Shimano brand/model/SKU/size identities and all 291 Shimano page entries. F versus A, FL versus FM, FB versus FC/FD, FC versus FD, FI versus FJ and FJ versus FK are separate verified generations. Compact C and HG/XG retained. Regional naming and package aliases are not counted separately.

notes: Published material-specific diameter and length; no lb or PE conversion used to invent a diameter.
